title: Fernbank Museum of Natural History

services.name: Indoor Exhibits
services.desc: An elevated walkway takes you from the museum’s Terrace into the treetops where you can enjoy stunning views looking out over Wildwoods. From there, you can tailor your experience. WildWoods is open year-round, rain or shine, but may be closed due to inclement weather. WildWoods is suitable for all ages and all fitness levels. It includes ADA-accessible trails and experiences. Fernbank has several volunteer opportunities to assist with restoration projects in our outdoor areas. services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Discover the World of WOW in a new, more personal way! You can now enhance your Fernbank visit with a private program or tour, in which a Fernbank educator will provide an individualized experience to your small group of up to 15 people. Enjoy a private presentation or demonstration from a Fernbank educator for your family or group. Programs are designed for ages 4 and over and parties of up to 15 people. Programs run approximately 15-20 minutes, with time for questions and discussion. Reservation Policies: Program reservations must be made at least one week in advance. services.name: Flora, Fauna & Flight
services.desc: Discover how plants and animals defy gravity through flight in this artistic outdoor exhibit along the nature walkways in WildWoods. A variety of colorful and photo-inspiring sculptures of birds, bees, dragonflies, butterflies, dandelions, cattails, flying fish, bats and more highlight the native flora and fauna of our region while showcasing their ability to fly or glide. Along the way, you’ll learn about the properties of flight, how plants and animals have evolved to fly, how their physical traits support the ability to soar through the air and more. Fernbank is a nonprofit natural history museum, giant screen theater and old-growth forest, and is not affiliated with Fernbank Science

services.desc: Fernbank's mission is to ignite a passion for science, nature and human culture through exploration and discovery. In addition to offering educational exhibits, movies and school programs, Fernbank also offers unique programs designed for a variety of ages and interests. You can help make even more possible. Double your Annual Fund gift through a generous Trustee Matching Challenge.
